question.problem:
$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3(x+{y}^{2})}{8}, & 0\le x\le 2,\,\,0\le y\le 1, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,{f}_{X}(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3x+1}{8}, & 0\le x\le 2, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$  be continuous random variables. Their joint probability density function and the marginal probability density function of $X$ are shown above. Find the conditional expected value $\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=1].$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional expected value of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=x]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }y\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)\,\text{d}y.
$$

Note that $\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=x]$ is a function of $x.$ 

The conditional density function of $Y$ given $X=x$ can be computed as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x) & =\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{X}(x)} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{3x+{y}^{2}}{8})}{(\frac{3x+1}{8})} \\  & =\frac{3(x+{y}^{2})}{3x+1},\end{aligned}
$$

 

where $0\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 1.$ Outside this domain, we have ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)=0.$

Now, substituting $x=1$ into the expression for ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x),$ we get

$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)=\frac{3(1+{y}^{2})}{3\cdot 1+1}=\frac{3(1+{y}^{2})}{4}.
$$

Therefore, using the definition of the conditional expectation above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=1] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }y\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}y\cdot \frac{3(1+{y}^{2})}{4}\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}(y+{y}^{3})\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{4}{[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}+\frac{{y}^{4}}{4}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}[(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4})-0] \\  & =\frac{9}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$
